newsitem.title: CHINA: China says summer grain crop seen at record.
newsitem.headline: China says summer grain crop seen at record.

text.p: China said on Monday it expected a record summer grain crop.
It gave no details but it said that the summer crop would represent 22 percent of the total grain harvest for the year. The summer crop would consist mainly of early rice and wheat.
The total area under cultivation for the summer crop stood at 31.8 million hectares, up 0.3 million hectares from last year, the Financial Daily said.
Favourable weather would also be a factor in the anticipated gains, it said.
China has said its total grain harvest last year was 490 million tonnes. It previously reported its summer harvest reached 114.1 million tonnes last year, representing about 23 percent of the total.
